name: io.github.BeppeTemp/cartographer
title: Cartographer
description: Governance MCP server for agent-maintained knowledge bases (OKF): git-backed writes, search, lint.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mounts your KB folder (the one holding data/index.md) onto /kb in the container.

kb_path.description: Absolute path of the KB folder on this machine, writable by the container user. Create one with `cartographer kb create`.
